create_weights_scheme: create weights for a compressed tensors quantization scheme on a layer
apply_weights_forward: apply weights to run the forward pass of a quantized layer with input tensor and optional bias
process_weights_after_loading: process and clean up weights after loading is complete for a quantization scheme
get_min_capability: get the minimum device capability required for a compressed tensors quantization scheme
review_compressed_tensors_scheme: review the abstract compressed tensors scheme class and its quantization methods
